title: Midweek micro-ops handoff: console + rollout bridge
content:
Midweek micro-ops handoff (30 Nov 2026) - quick capture

Attendees: Asha, Diego, Priya, Liam, Janelle (10:30-11:00 PT)
Location: #console-rollouts (Slack) + brief phone bridge
Purpose: align UI, rollout gating, and analytics signals for the midweek canary and handoff to on-call

Agenda:
- Quick surface-level health check (UI / Rollout / Analytics)
- Canaries: results, anomalies, throttles
- Action item reassignments for evening patch window
- Known risks and rollback triggers
- Notes to on-call: what to watch at 21:00 PT

1) Quick health check (by area)
- UI (Priya): no major regressions in panel rendering on desktop. 2 regressions surfaced on mobile (iOS 17 Safari) where the panel header collapses on scroll — reproducer in RINF-2512. Workaround: force-stacking header via CSS var; hotfix PR ready but needs design signoff.
- Rollouts (Asha/Diego): Canary traffic 12% -> goal 15% today. Traffic throttled at edge for a short window (09:05-09:12) due to autoscaling lag on dedicated nodes; scaled fine after 90s. Fallback routing triggered for 137 requests -> served by variant-v1b. No user-facing errors.
- Analytics (Liam): telemetry pipeline ingestion lag peaked at 2.2m at 08:45 due to a transient Kafka partition skew; catch-up finished by 09:40. Some event deduping observed (duplicate session IDs) — investigating. Dashboards currently showing baseline metrics fine.

2) Canary outcomes and anomalies
- Successes: latency p50 for UI route /panel/render is 110ms (target 140ms). Memory on dedicated pool stable.
- Anomalies: 0.2% elevation in token-generation time for sandbox customers when routed to quantized model variant; correlates with queue depth during the throttle window. Suggestion: temporarily pin sandbox -> non-quantized variant for next 6 hours if trend continues. (Action: Diego)
- Failure modes observed: mobile header collapse (see UI), duplicate analytics events (Liam). No rollback needed at present.

3) Action items (owner — ETA — notes)
- Priya — open hotfix PR for mobile header and add layout test for iOS Safari — ETA: 2026-12-01 16:00 PT — PR: GH/console#987 (needs design signoff).
- Diego — add short-term route rule to pin sandbox customers to non-quantized model variant; monitor token latency (alert if p95 > 800ms) — ETA: 2026-11-30 17:30 PT — JIRA: RINF-2450.
- Liam — investigate duplicate session IDs ingestion; check producer side dedupe flags and Kafka consumer offsets; roll a small patch to analytics schema if needed — ETA: 2026-12-01 end of day.
- Asha — document evening patch checklist for on-call (21:00 PT patch window) and confirm rollback playbook + who executes which step — ETA: 2026-11-30 19:00 PT.
- Janelle — prepare short signal summary for #oncall with three clear watch metrics (UI error rate, model token latency p95, analytics ingestion lag) — ETA: 2026-11-30 20:00 PT.

4) Blockers / open questions
- Design signoff pending for mobile header hotfix; if delayed, we may need a CSS-only cautious fallback (Priya to propose).
- Is the autoscaler policy change (temporary bump to target below 200ms cold-start) acceptable for Dedicated pools during the canary? Ops/infra approval needed — ticket RINF-2512 referenced.
- Should we enable a short-term debug flag (telemetry sampling + extra metadata) for the canary traffic to help correlate token latency spikes? Risk: additional cost and storage. (Decision deferred to on-call if spikes return).

5) Rollback triggers (explicit) — to be posted to #oncall and attached to the evening checklist
- UI error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5 minutes across canary users -> revert front-end build.
- Model token p95 > 1200ms for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows -> switch routing to baseline model variant.
- Analytics ingestion lag > 15 minutes and backlog growth > 10k events in 10m window -> pause feature-event emission and escalate.

6) Notes for on-call (short bullet list)
- Watch metrics: UI render errors, model token p95, analytics ingestion lag (dashboards linked).
- Quick remediations: pin routing, flip feature flag, revert front-end bundle (commands below).
- Revert front-end: `deploy rollback --service=console-web --to=stable-2026-11-29` (run from infra-cli).
- Pin routing example: `redwood route set --selector=sandbox --variant=baseline-v1` (requires ops token).

7) Misc / TODOs for next sync
- Add an automated smoke check for mobile header on iOS (small Cypress job). Priya to author ticket.
- Add a short-runbook section that explains the duplicate-session-ID symptom and steps to triage in consumer service. Liam to draft.
- Postmortem-ish: if duplicate events root cause is producer-side, plan a 2-hour window to patch producers and reprocess backlog.

8) Quick retrospective (2 min)
- What went well: cross-team triage was fast; canary telemetry surfaced early.
- What to improve: clearer pre-canary autoscaler ramp parameters and a fast path for temporary route pins.

End of notes.

Unresolved fragments / notes-to-self:
- Capture log sample for autoscaler lag (Asha) -> /logs/infra/2026-11-30/autoscaler-throttle-09-05.log
- Add explicit dashboard tile for quantized vs non-quantized token-time comparison (Liam).

Next sync: quick handoff in #console-rollouts at 20:15 PT (same day) before patch window.
